Feature: GPIO Register Reset and Read/Write Integrity
Test Description: Validate that GPIO GP0 pad registers (8-27) power-on defaults match specification (with input bit0 ignored) and that masked write/read operations across multiple data patterns update only writable bits while preserving read-only bits.
Meta Test Description: The test executes test_case() which calls chk_rst_val() then chk_rd_wr(), and finally reports finish(0) on success or finish(1) on failure based on def_fail_cnt and wr_fail_cnt. In chk_rst_val(): for i in [0..CNT-1], addr=addr_array[i]; skip if skip_rst_array[i]==1 or read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000; read data_rd=read_reg(addr), compute data=(data_rd & 0xFFFFFFFE) to ignore bit0; compare data to default_value_array[i]; on mismatch, increment def_fail_cnt and log failure. In chk_rd_wr(): iterate over six patterns chk_val={0xFFFFFFFF,0xAAAAAAAA,0x55555555,0xF5F5F5F5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xFFFF0000}. For each pattern: Write phase: for each i, skip if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000; else write_reg(addr_array[i], (pattern & write_mask_array[i])). Read/verify phase: for each i, skip if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 or read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000; else read data_rd=(read_reg(addr_array[i]) & read_mask_array[i]); compute wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) and exp_val=((pattern & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if data_rd!=exp_val then wr_fail_cnt++ and log mismatch.
Remarks: Default-value comparison masks off bit0 due to input pin behavior. Any register with read mask 0 is treated as not readable and skipped; any with write mask 0 is treated as not writable and skipped. Skip controls are configured to skip none in this run. Optional soft reset check is compiled out.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Read GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_27 and verify each register's default value with the input bit (bit0) ignored. 2) For each of six data patterns, program all writable GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_27 registers using their write masks. 3) Read back the registers applying read masks and verify that writable bits reflect the pattern while non-writable bits retain default values. 4) Declare the test PASS only if all default checks and all write/read verifications succeed; otherwise mark FAIL.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: Initialization: def_fail_cnt=0; wr_fail_cnt=0. chk_rst_val(): for (i=0..CNT-1): addr=addr_array[i]; if (skip_rst_array[i]==1) continue; if (read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000) continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); data=(data_rd & 0xFFFFFFFE); if (data==default_value_array[i]) {log pass} else {def_fail_cnt++; log failure}. chk_rd_wr(): chk_val[6]={0xFFFFFFFF,0xAAAAAAAA,0x55555555,0xF5F5F5F5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xFFFF0000}; for each pattern data_wr: Write loop (i=0..CNT-1): skip if skip_array[i]==1 or write_mask==0; write_reg(addr, (data_wr & write_mask_array[i])). Read/verify loop: skip if skip/write_mask/read_mask==0; data_rd=(read_reg(addr) & read_mask); wr_n=(write_mask^0xFFFFFFFF); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask & write_mask)|(wr_n & read_mask & default_value)); compare. Completion: finish(0) if both counts==0 else finish(1).

Otherwise FAIL.

Feature: GPIO Negative Edge Interrupt Detection and Handling
Test Description: Verify that each of the 32 GPIO pads (GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_39) can detect a negative-edge interrupt individually. The test configures each pad for negedge interrupt mode, drives a falling edge, validates that the ISR fires, checks interrupt status bits, clears the interrupt, and verifies the status is fully cleared.
Meta Test Description: test_case() initializes test_err=0, enables GIC IRQ (87 for GPIO0 or 88 for GPIO1), enables sysreg interrupt via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1. Drives all pads high via write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF). Configures all 32 pads for negedge interrupt by writing (1<<20)|(1<<18)|(1<<16) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) for i=0..31. For each pad i=0..31: clears raw status by writing (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; enables interrupt bit by writing (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1; sets int_pend=1; drives all pads high then drives negedge by writing ~(1<<i) to 0xA0243ffc; polls int_pend with timeout=5000. Default_IRQHandler: sets int_pend=0; drives pads high; reads pad register rdata=read_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+i*4); checks (rdata & 0x1)==0 (input low after negedge); checks (rdata & 0x2)!=0 (interrupt status set); reads group status rdata_grp=read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) and verifies (rdata_grp & (1<<i))!=0; clears interrupt by writing (1<<20)|(1<<16) to pad register; clears raw status via GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; re-reads group status and verifies ==0; clears sysreg status and GIC IRQ.
Remarks: Test uses conditional compilation (#ifdef GPIO0/#ifdef GPIO1) to select between GPIO controller instances. GIC IRQ 87 is used for GPIO0 and IRQ 88 for GPIO1. The external signal stimulus is driven via memory-mapped address 0xA0243ffc. Timeout of 5000 iterations is used to prevent infinite hangs if interrupt does not fire.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Enable GIC IRQ and sysreg interrupt for the GPIO controller instance. 2) Drive all 32 GPIO pads high. 3) Configure all 32 pads for negative-edge interrupt mode by setting bits 20, 18, and 16 in each pad register. 4) For each pad i (0-31): clear raw interrupt status, enable interrupt for pad i, drive a falling edge on pad i, wait for ISR to fire. 5) In ISR: verify pad input is low (bit0==0), verify interrupt status is set (bit1!=0), read and verify group interrupt status bit for pad i, clear interrupt, clear raw status, verify group status is fully cleared, clear sysreg status and GIC IRQ. 6) Report PASS if all 32 pads pass; otherwise FAIL.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: Initialization: test_err=0. GIC_EnableIRQ(87 or 88). write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, GPIO_INTR). write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF). For i=0..31: write_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4), (1<<20)|(1<<18)|(1<<16)). For i=0..31: wr_val=(1<<i); write_reg(GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, wr_val); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~wr_val); poll int_pend with timeout=5000. ISR: int_pend=0; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); rdata=read_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+i*4); if (rdata&1)!=0 test_err++; if (rdata&2)!=0: rdata_grp=read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp & wr_val)==0 test_err++; write_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+i*4, (1<<20)|(1<<16)); write_reg(GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, wr_val); rdata_grp=read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if rdata_grp!=0 test_err++; clear sysreg and GIC. else test_err++. finish(test_err).
Impacted Registers: GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_39 (32 pads), GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1, GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
Meta Impacted Registers: MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_39, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1, MIZAR_GPIO_GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: PASS if all 32 GPIO pads successfully detect a negative-edge interrupt, the ISR fires within timeout, pad input reads low after negedge, group interrupt status bit is set for the correct pad, interrupt clearing succeeds (group status returns to 0), and sysreg status is cleared. FAIL if any pad times out or any status check fails.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: For each pad i=0..31: (1) ISR must fire (int_pend becomes 0 before timeout); (2) (read_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+i*4) & 0x1)==0; (3) (read_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+i*4) & 0x2)!=0; (4) (read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1) & (1<<i))!=0; (5) after clearing: read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1)==0. Any violation increments test_err. Final: finish(test_err) where test_err==0 means PASS.

Feature: GPIO Positive Edge Interrupt Detection and Handling for All Pads
Test Description: Verify that all 32 GPIO pads (GP0_GPIO_8 to GP0_GPIO_39) can detect a positive-edge interrupt. The test configures each pad for posedge interrupt mode, sets IO control groups, enables group interrupts, drives a rising edge per pad, validates ISR fires, checks group interrupt status, clears per-pin raw status, verifies group status cleared, and validates sysreg status clearing.
Meta Test Description: test_case() enables GIC IRQ (87 for GPIO0 or 88 for GPIO1), enables sysreg interrupt via MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1. Configures all 32 pads for posedge interrupt by writing 0x00020000 (bit17=1) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) for i=0..31. Sets IO control groups: write_reg(GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1..GROUP4, 0x000000FF). Enables all group interrupts: write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF). For each pad i=0..31: drives low via write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); sets int_pend=1; drives rising edge via write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); polls int_pend with timeout=2000; drives low again. Default_IRQHandler: wr_val=(1<<i); int_pend=0; reads rdata_grp=read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); masks group interrupt write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000); checks (rdata_grp & 0xFFFFFFFF)!=0 else test_err++; clears per-pin raw status by writing 0x00010000 (bit16=iclr) to all 32 pad registers; re-reads group status and verifies ==0 else test_err++; clears sysreg status and verifies cleared else test_err++; re-enables group interrupt write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF); clears GIC IRQ.
Remarks: Test uses conditional compilation (#ifdef GPIO0/#ifdef GPIO1) for GPIO controller instance selection. IO control groups 1-4 are configured to 0xFF to set pads in input mode. Group interrupt enable covers all 32 bits. External stimulus via 0xA0243ffc. Timeout of 2000 iterations prevents infinite hangs. ISR masks group interrupt during service and re-enables after clearing to prevent re-entry.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Enable GIC IRQ and sysreg interrupt for the GPIO controller instance. 2) Configure all 32 pads for positive-edge interrupt mode (bit17=1 in each pad register). 3) Set IO control groups 1-4 to 0xFF for input mode. 4) Enable all group interrupts (GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1=0xFFFFFFFF). 5) For each pad i (0-31): drive all pads low, arm int_pend, drive rising edge, wait for ISR with timeout. 6) In ISR: read group interrupt status and verify non-zero, mask group interrupt, clear per-pin raw status for all 32 pads (write bit16 to each pad register), verify group status cleared to 0, clear and verify sysreg status, re-enable group interrupt, clear GIC IRQ. 7) Report PASS if all 32 pads pass; otherwise FAIL.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: Initialization: test_err=0. GIC_EnableIRQ(87 or 88). write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, GPIO_INTR). For i=0..31: write_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4), 0x00020000). write_reg(GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1..4, 0x000000FF). write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF). For i=0..31: write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000); int_pend=1; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xFFFFFFFF); poll int_pend with timeout=2000; write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0x00000000). ISR: wr_val=(1<<i); int_pend=0; rdata_grp=read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000); if (rdata_grp & 0xFFFFFFFF)==0 test_err++; for j=0..31: write_reg(GP0_GPIO_8+(j*4), 0x00010000); rdata_grp=read_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if rdata_grp!=0 test_err++; clear sysreg and verify; write_reg(GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0xFFFFFFFF); GIC_ClearIRQ. finish(test_err).
